· MACD histogram -6408.1700 → -2113.6200 (improving): signal of weakening bearishness, trend reversal unconfirmed

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· 5-day high/low (KRW 228,000/KRW 203,500), 20-day high/low (KRW 285,500/KRW 203,500): confirming sideways pattern
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.05): normal level, moderate confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI sideways in neutral zone, weak ADX trend necessitates continued wait-and-see approach
